revision_summary: Two quote timestamp errors flagged by the deterministic check need fixing: (1) 'No, sir. I mean, you guys tell me this. You tell me nothing out of pocket.' is actually at 00:30, not 00:06 -- fix the ts in script_coverage[0].intro_legitimacy's customer_quote field. (2) 'Yeah. I can do tomorrow at 12:30.' is actually at 02:27, not 01:51 -- fix the ts in script_coverage[11].appointment_set's customer_quote field. Both are minor wrong_ts errors (words exist, timestamp is off) but should be corrected on rerun. Additionally, Stage 3 should be more consistent about flagging the broken diarization (every line tagged 'rep:') at each point where it attributes a specific line to 'the customer' or 'the rep' in rep_intent, state_changes, and cherry_pick_moments -- right now the ambiguity is only surfaced once in trajectory_verdict.outcome_dispute, but the confident line-by-line attributions elsewhere imply more certainty than the source transcript supports. Also recommend surfacing the recycled-lead signal at 00:09-00:13 ('we never got a chance to get that evaluation to you') as a concrete missed_moment tied to context.lead_types_and_bill_collection_rules -- it's a sharper explanation for the customer's pre-formed hostility than the vague 'prior touch' framing currently used in starting_state and handoff_brief. Finally, add a brief note on the missing co-owner/title question (verify.title_co_owners) as a qualification gap in observed_outcome or handoff_brief, since it's a required verify item that was never asked before booking.
